description: The pause, a token with the phoneme tag `/./`, is labelled as a space, whether a rule emits it over text or inserts it. A token over pauses keeps only the first of each run of pause parts and none at either end, in its label as in its phonemes (engine §5).

documents.g.md:
```jbogenbau %ambiguity-resolution greedy %rule text [part] ... %rule part letter | pause %rule letter $c('a') %emits $c , /./ %rule pause '-' | pause '-' %emits $

```
documents.h.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text $w(all)
%emits $w <W>
%rule all [any] ...
%rule any L | P | /./
```
